intent: Agent tool get_finance per finance.md: RLS-scoped totals by category + recent entries, decimal amounts, no identities, max 50, deep links, audited; no finance.read -> nothing.
summary: Implemented PSI-105. New src/agent/tools/get-finance.ts (get_finance): zod input {eventId?, boardId?, from?, to?, category?, limit 1..50 default 20}; output {currency:'IDR', totals:{inflow,outflow,net}, byCategory:[{category,direction,total,count}], recent:[{occurredOn,direction,amount,currency,category,description,board,event?,link}]} per finance.md. Totals/byCategory come from the agent_finance security-invoker view (filters: board_id/event_id/category eq; from/to applied as group-span overlap on first_on/last_on, documented in the description); recent rows come from finance_entries with exact occurred_on gte/lte filters, order occurred_on DESC, capped at limit via both .limit() and a defensive slice. Amounts are decimal strings (formatAmount rounds to 2 places, no float on the wire); category slugs, no creator identities (created_at is selected but never emitted); deep links: event link when event_id present else board link. RLS decides visibility: a caller without finance.read gets empty data (tested). Registered in registry.ts -> exposed automatically to both the MCP adapter (/api/mcp) and the in-app chat adapter. Upgraded the shared fake-supabase Builder to actually apply eq/gte/lt/lte/ilike filters, order and limit (it was a pass-through), so tools are tested against real scoping. 6 new unit tests in get-finance.test.ts (contract/limit, aggregation math, recent shape+links+no-identity, cap, RLS-empty, filter propagation) + 1 registry-count + 1 output-cap test in agent.test.ts. Gates: 56/56 frontend, 15/15 edge fns, tsc clean, oxlint 0/0.

changes.note: 6 unit tests incl. caller-without-finance.read gets nothing
registry count 5->6; get_finance limit>50 cap test
Builder now applies filters/order/limit like PostgREST

decisions.decision: Totals/byCategory read the agent_finance view (security_invoker), recent reads finance_entries with joins for board/category/event names
decisions.reason: Matches finance.md and the M8 agent-layer pattern: the view runs as the caller so RLS decides what the agent sees; the plain rows give exact per-entry dates for from/to filtering and deep links.

decisions.decision: Date range on totals = group-span overlap (first_on/last_on gte/lte), exact on recent rows
decisions.reason: agent_finance is grouped per (board,event,category,direction) and has no per-entry dates; first_on/last_on are precisely the overlap columns. Documented in the tool description so the model does not assume exact from/to totals.
The 'max 50' contract is enforced even if a future code path stops passing limit (and the fake Builder's old pass-through would have silently returned 60).

decisions.decision: Deep link = event detail when event_id set, else board link
decisions.reason: The dashboard has no per-finance-entry route; events and boards are the closest navigable anchors (links.ts pattern).

decisions.decision: Upgraded the shared fake-supabase Builder to apply filters/sort/limit
decisions.reason: A pass-through fake lets a tool 'work' against rows it would never see; filtering for real means tests assert actual scoping instead of fixture luck.

verification.manual: bun test src/ 56/56 (6 new get_finance + registry/cap tests), bun test supabase/functions 15/15, tsc --noEmit clean, oxlint 0 warnings 0 errors. No DB migration in this card; pgTAP 135 unchanged.

When the dashboard gains a per-finance-entry route, update links.ts so get_finance deep-links to the entry itself.
